k:煮.mnemonic: Someone (者) stands over the flames (灬) stirring a pot until the water bubbles hard and the vegetables turn soft. Boil (cook).

k:朴.mnemonic: His divining rod (卜) is just a forked twig snapped off a tree (木), with the bark still on. No polish and no carving. Crude (simple, plain, docile).
k:朴.hint: A twig with the bark still on.

k:盆.mnemonic: A dish (皿) so wide and deep that the water in it is shared out, a part (分) for each person in the family to wash in. Basin (lantern festival, tray).
k:盆.hint: Wide deep dish of shared water.

k:冥.mnemonic: At six (六) the day (日) pulls a cover down over its forehead (冖) like a hat over the eyes, and all the light is gone. Dark.
k:冥.hint: Day pulls its hat down at six.

k:砕.mnemonic: A stone (石) dropped from the tower breaks into nine (九) lumps, and each lump bursts into a thousand (千) splinters. Smash (break, crush, familiar).

k:蓄.mnemonic: The farmer piles dried flowers (艹) and hay above the barn of his livestock (畜), heap upon heap, enough fodder for three winters. Amass (raise, hoard, store).
k:蓄.hint: Hay heaped high over the barn.

k:膳.mnemonic: The virtuous (善) monk eats kneeling at a tray on short legs, and through a whole month (月) of fasting it holds just one bowl of rice. Small low table (tray).

k:貌.mnemonic: A white (白) badger (豸) stands up on its hind legs (儿) in front of the mirror, checking its face and its figure from every side. Form (appearance, countenance, shape).
k:貌.hint: Badger admiring itself in the mirror.

k:宴.mnemonic: For one day (日) nobody works: everyone can relax (安) at long tables piled high with food and drink. Banquet (feast, party).
k:宴.hint: Long tables, a day off for all.

k:豚.mnemonic: A pig (豕) after a month (月) at the butcher's: no longer an animal in the yard but chops and bacon on the plate. Pork (pig).
k:豚.hint: From the yard to chops and bacon.

k:頓.mnemonic: A soldier in the barracks (屯) turns a page (頁) of his book and a shellfish (貝) snaps shut on his finger, out of nowhere. Suddenly (immediately, in a hurry, arrange).
k:頓.hint: Snap! A clam between the pages.

k:盲.mnemonic: An eye (目) whose sight is deceased (亡): it is open and looking, but no picture arrives. Blind (blind man, ignoramus).

k:娠.mnemonic: A woman (女) carrying something precious and growing inside her, the way a clam (辰) carries its pearl. With child (pregnancy).
k:娠.hint: Like a clam carrying a pearl.

k:椎.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) pecks about under a tree (木) for the small sweet nuts it drops, a relative of the chestnut. Chinquapin (mallet, spine).
k:椎.hint: Turkey pecking up small sweet nuts.

k:膚.mnemonic: Tiger stripes (虍) painted across the stomach (胃): the pattern sits on the outer layer of the body and goes no deeper. Skin (body, grain, texture).

k:禅.mnemonic: Before a bare altar (礻) a monk sits with a simple (単) task: breathe, and think of nothing at all. Zen (silent meditation).

k:曇.mnemonic: The sun of the day (日) is up there somewhere, but beneath it the rain (雨) that has not yet fallen wraps the sky in a grey cocoon (厶). Cloudy weather (cloud up).
k:曇.hint: Sun hidden above a grey wrapping.

k:拙.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) fumble the plate and it makes its exit (出) from his hands to the floor. That is the third one today. Bungling (clumsy, unskillful).

k:湧.mnemonic: Water with the courage (勇) of a tsunami (氵) bursts up out of the ground and refuses to be held down. Gush (boil, well up, ferment).
k:湧.hint: Brave water bursting from the ground.

k:閑.mnemonic: The gate (門) is barred with a tree (木) trunk. No visitors and no errands today, just a whole afternoon to yourself. Leisure.

k:窮.mnemonic: Somebody (身) living in a hole (穴), bent like a bow (弓) because the roof is too low, without a single coin to move elsewhere. Hard up (destitute, suffer, perplexed).
k:窮.hint: Bent double in a cramped hole.

k:蚊.mnemonic: An insect (虫) that whines in your ear just as you try to write a sentence (文): you slap, miss, and lose your place. Mosquito.
k:蚊.hint: A whine in your ear mid-line.

k:冗.mnemonic: You rest your forehead (冖) on the table (几) while the speaker makes the same point for the fifth time. Not a word of it was needed. Superfluous (uselessness).
k:冗.hint: Head on the desk, fifth repetition.

k:慕.mnemonic: At dusk (暮) the heart (心) aches most for the one who is far away: you watch the road until the light is gone. Pining (yearn for, love dearly, adore).

k:粗.mnemonic: The rice (米) is unpolished, husks and all, and moreover (且) there is grit in it that scrapes your tongue. Coarse (rough, rugged).
k:粗.hint: Husky rice with grit in it.

k:腫.mnemonic: Yesterday (昨) it was a small bump. After a month (月) it is as round as the hill behind your hometown (里), and you go to the doctor. Tumor (swelling).
k:腫.hint: A bump grown round as a hill.

k:寮.mnemonic: One roof (宀) over students big (大) and small (小): at the end of each day (日) they all come back to their rows of bunks. Dormitory (hostel, villa, tea pavillion).
k:寮.hint: Rows of bunks under one roof.

k:欄.mnemonic: The east (東) gate (門) has a railing of upright posts. Between each pair is a tall blank space, like the ruled spaces across a newspaper page. Column (handrail, blank, space).

k:糧.mnemonic: Rice (米) weighed out in exactly the quantity (量) the expedition needs: so many sacks per person for the whole journey. Provisions (food, bread).
k:糧.hint: Sacks weighed out for the journey.
